mechanism: Amphotericin B nephrotoxicity is potentiated by ritonavir, which may impair renal function and increase drug accumulation; both agents can cause electrolyte abnormalities and cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (K+, Mg2+), and cardiac status closely; consider alternative antifungal therapy or use lipid formulation of amphotericin B if combination is necessary.
